description:
The Maven goals that bind governance checks and explicit repair operations to the build. A check
        reads the tree without changing it unless a repair switch is set for it, and no switch is set by
        an ordinary build. The assets-sync goal writes only when called directly, and source-formatting
        writes only under the format profile.

        A check that shipped as a test could be accidentally deselected by -Dtest=OneClass. As goals the
        checks stay bound to their phases, their parameters are named and typed, and a failure names the
        check in the line that reports it. Every goal honors -DskipTests as the quality and governance
        bypass, except the publication checks, which a release must answer even though it skips the tests
        it already ran.
